recognize_zh: 右下方一顆大型漿細胞內有四個核（四核漿細胞），細胞質豐富灰藍；周圍同時有大量核偏位的單核漿細胞與少數小淋巴球。多核漿細胞本身屬非典型改變，配合大量漿細胞支持漿細胞骨髓瘤。影像略失焦。
features: Large plasma cell with four nuclei clustered within abundant cytoplasm (tetranucleate form, lower right)
Numerous background plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm
Some large plasma cells with open chromatin and visible nucleoli
Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional fine cytoplasmic vacuoles
Slight blur and pink precipitate/fibrin in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, including large forms with visible nucleoli. A large tetranucleate plasma cell is present. Scattered small lymphocytes are seen, and image focus is slightly suboptimal. Multinucleated plasma cells are an atypical feature; together with the clinical findings of vertebral fractures, anemia, renal impairment and an M-protein, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma pending plasma cell quantitation and clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm and osteoclasts have many separate nuclei with pink granular cytoplasm, whereas this cell has a few eccentric plasma cell-type nuclei in basophilic cytoplasm.
Reactive plasma cells are mature, mononuclear and polytypic, without multinucleated atypical forms.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma with multinucleated tumor cells
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin-positive, whereas plasma cells are discohesive and CD138-positive.
